$ krs emit-k --package tour-light --definition main --output target/krs-k
emitted definition.k, symbols.json, sources.json
$ cat target/krs-k/definition.k
// Generated by `krs emit-k` from krs, tour-light. Do not edit; edit the Rust sources and emit again.
// The `// KRS <package>/<file>: <item>` line above a sentence names the Rust item it comes from.
// A default label spells that item's path: `<namespace>--<module>--…--<item>`.
// Mutations of this K are patches in the corpus's mutations/<topic>.toml (kink/ beside Cargo.toml by default), each edit anchored by `rule = <label>`;
// `krs kink check` resolves them and shows each edit's Rust line. Why K patches, not Rust edits: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/k-rust/blob/main/kink/decisions.md#m-mutation-input

module KRS-FRAMEWORK
  syntax KItem
  syntax KResult

  syntax KItem ::= KResult
endmodule

module LIGHT-SYNTAX
  imports KRS-FRAMEWORK

  syntax Light

  // KRS tour-light/src/lib.rs: LightSyntax::Green
  syntax Light ::= "green" [symbol(lightSyntaxGreen), format(%1)]
  // KRS tour-light/src/lib.rs: LightSyntax::Red
  syntax Light ::= "red" [symbol(lightSyntaxRed), format(%1)]
endmodule

module LIGHT
  imports KRS-FRAMEWORK
  imports LIGHT-SYNTAX

  syntax KItem ::= Light

  // KRS tour-light/src/lib.rs: Machine
  configuration
    <k> $PGM:Light </k>


  // KRS tour-light/src/lib.rs: red_to_green
  rule [red-to-green]:
    <k> red => green ... </k>
endmodule
